entries.gated_by: default pytest suite (python/tests/test_fitness_report.py, test_large_module_review.py, test_src_dependency_boundaries.py, test_stranded_doc_comments.py); no CI workflow runs the general suite
entries.notes: Used by tools/defuse_ratchet.py per the earlier grep? actually the reverse: fitness_report.py is referenced FROM tools/defuse_ratchet.py's docstring/imports.

entries.title: Fixture corpus compile + execution-differential harness
entries.subject: Compiles the fixture corpus across the {gcc,clang}x{O0,O2} matrix and runs the fail-closed execution-differential gate, producing the per-function result map the CI decompiler gate consumes.
entries.gated_by: CI (.github/workflows/decompiler-fixtures.yml, both the fast and matrix jobs)
entries.notes: One of the few tools/ files with a direct, confirmed CI caller.

entries.title: Fingerprinted compile toolchain contract
entries.subject: Defines and verifies the fingerprinted Docker compile toolchain used by every stage of the fixture gate, so baseline verdicts stay tied to a pinned compiler set.
entries.gated_by: CI (.github/workflows/decompiler-fixtures.yml, both fast and matrix jobs, right after the docker build step)

entries.title: Regenerate defuse_baseline.json
entries.subject: Regenerates tests/decompiler_fixtures/defuse_baseline.json, the committed per-function def-before-use census the ratchet compares against.
entries.gated_by: manual only, run after independently confirming a change is real (CLAUDE.md); never to make a red gate green
entries.notes: CLAUDE.md: an arity fix once shipped with this baseline unrefreshed because the census lane isn't in any fast gate list.

entries.title: glaurung.dev fixture gallery JSON
entries.subject: Runs every fixture across all toolchain/optimization lanes and emits the JSON that renders the public glaurung.dev fixture gallery, including the pass/fail execution-differential verdict per function.
entries.gated_by: nothing calls it; manual publishing tool writing outside this repo (a sibling glaurung.dev checkout)
entries.notes: Most recently modified file in tools/ (Aug 31, same day as this survey). No caller anywhere in-repo -- entirely a human-run publishing step.

entries.title: Regenerate PyO3 .pyi stubs
entries.subject: Generates python/glaurung/_native/*.pyi from the BUILT native module -- the replacement for the two hand-written stubs CLAUDE.md documents as having caused 81% of a 2,004-diagnostic ty run.
entries.gated_by: default pytest suite (python/tests/test_native_stub_current.py regenerates-and-diffs); no CI workflow runs the general suite, so staleness is only caught by that test or a manual --check
entries.notes: CLAUDE.md: 'Never hand-write a .pyi' -- this is the only sanctioned generator.

entries.title: Regenerate realistic-corpus discovery baseline
entries.subject: Regenerates tests/realistic_corpus/discovery_baseline.json, the ratchet python/tests/test_realistic_corpus.py compares function-discovery results against.
entries.gated_by: manual only; consumed by python/tests/test_realistic_corpus.py which is itself skipif-gated (default suite when its precondition holds)
entries.notes: Calls tools/build_guard.py before regenerating, per the guard-before-baseline discipline in CLAUDE.md.

entries.title: Regenerate structural_baseline.json
entries.subject: Regenerates tests/decompiler_fixtures/structural_baseline.json, the committed textual-output baseline the structural lane diffs against (fails on ANY change, regression or improvement).
entries.gated_by: manual only, run after independently confirming an improvement is real; consumed by CI (decompiler-fixtures.yml matrix job via test_decompiler_fixture_structural.py)
entries.notes: One of the four baselines CLAUDE.md says must ALL be refreshed together when a fixture is added.

entries.title: Ghidra comparator decompile
entries.subject: Decompiles named functions with Ghidra headless as the production-reference comparator, chosen because angr alone was 'the comparator that makes the numbers survivable'.
entries.gated_by: manual only; invoked by tools/roundtrip3.py and tools/angr_decompile.py's sibling flow, not wired to CI

entries.title: Pass-trace health report
entries.subject: Converts GLAURUNG_PASS_HEALTH=1 JSONL pass traces into attributed per-pass health reports.
entries.runs_by: GLAURUNG_PASS_HEALTH=1 glaurung decompile ... 2> log; tools/pass_health_report.py log
entries.gated_by: default pytest suite (python/tests/test_pass_health_report.py); opt-in trace capture, no CI caller

entries.title: Pipeline timing/profile report
entries.subject: Summarizes GLAURUNG_PIPELINE_PROFILE=1 opt-in pipeline timing and object-parse traces.
entries.runs_by: GLAURUNG_PIPELINE_PROFILE=1 glaurung decompile ... 2> log; tools/pipeline_profile_report.py log
entries.gated_by: default pytest suite (python/tests/test_pipeline_profile_report.py); opt-in trace capture, no CI caller

entries.title: Realistic whole-binary corpus builder
entries.subject: Links a spread of no-main fixture translation units against a generated driver to build real, running, strippable/packable binaries -- the fixture corpus lacks entry points, PLT, and dynamic segments on its own.
entries.gated_by: default pytest suite (test_realistic_corpus.py, test_declared_extent_gate.py, skipif-gated on toolchain availability)
entries.notes: Imports tools/scratch.py.

entries.title: Recompiled-source fidelity measure
entries.subject: Measures how close recompiled recovered C is to the code it came from -- the only gate that asks what the recovered code LOOKS like, as opposed to what it DOES (execution differential) or a synthetic GED score (decbench_matrix).
entries.notes: Called by tools/decbench_holdout.py. Imports tools/diff_decompile.py and tools/scratch.py.

entries.title: Three-way C->binary->C round trip
entries.subject: For every (program, compiler, opt) tuple, decompiles with glaurung, Ghidra and angr and writes one side-by-side markdown per program, function by function.
entries.runs_by: tools/roundtrip3.py --out DIR [--programs a b c] [--lanes gcc:O0]
entries.gated_by: manual only; referenced from python/glaurung/cli/commands/decompile.py and a July 2026 diary, not from CI
entries.notes: Uses tools/angr_decompile.py and tools/ghidra_decompile.py as comparators.

entries.title: Source-vs-decompiled review with verdict
entries.subject: Puts source and decompiled C side by side with a human verdict -- the check CLAUDE.md-adjacent docs credit with catching a case where a perfect graph-edit-distance score hid undefined overlapping locals.
entries.notes: Calls tools/decbench_compare.py and tools/dectest.py.

entries.title: Shared TMPDIR-off-/tmp import
entries.subject: Import-only module that points TMPDIR at a directory on the root filesystem unless already set, preventing the shared /tmp tmpfs from silently corrupting test/gate runs.
entries.gated_by: unit-tested via python/tests/test_scratch_stays_off_tmpfs.py, which parametrizes a WIRED_TOOLS list and fails if a tool loses the import
entries.notes: Not really a standalone tool -- a safety library imported by 9 other tools/ files (arch_roundtrip, decompiler_output_canaries, gen_realistic_baseline, dectest, fixture_harness, diff_decompile, gen_structural_baseline, realistic_corpus, recompile_fidelity). CLAUDE.md's /tmp-quota incidents motivate it.

entries.title: Stripped-binary differential lane
entries.subject: Decompiles the SAME compile with debug info stripped and diffs verdicts against the -g build's, covering the blind spot every other lane has (they all compile with -g unconditionally).
entries.gated_by: scripts/decbench-local-gate.sh lane 2 (joined in, -m slow); marked slow so excluded from any non-slow default run
entries.notes: Imports tools/dectest.py and tools/fixture_harness.py.
